    The distinguished stable socle extension in a finite functor category #

    At a nonprojective indecomposable endpoint over an algebraically closed field, the residue map of the local endomorphism algebra descends to projective-stable endomorphisms and takes the stable identity to one. The finite-representable stable Hom--Ext formula transports this functional to a nonzero extension class. Pullback along every nonretraction kills that class, so every short exact realization has a right almost-split terminal map.
